meta.title: Eyadaty — Clinic Management Software for Private Doctors in Egypt
meta.desc: Eyadaty is clinic management software for private doctors in Egypt: patient records, visits, live clinic queues, prescriptions and nurse workflows — in Arabic and English, with medical data kept doctor-only.
hero.badge: Built for private clinics in Egypt
hero.title:
Run your clinic.
Keep patient recordd private.
hero.lead: Eyadaty gives doctors and their nurses one calm workspace for patients, visits, live queues and prescriptions — across every clinic you run, in Arabic or English.
f1.s: Sara moved to #2 · by Nurse Nour
feat.t: From the front desk to the consultation room
feat.p: One record per visit, one queue per clinic, and nothing your nurses shouldn't see.
f.1p: A permanent Patient ID, instant search by ID, phone or name, and duplicate-phone protection built in.
f.2p: Every visit is the appointment and the history entry. New visits and follow-ups, with no double-booking on the same day.
f.3p: Each clinic runs its own queue. Nurses reorder waiting patients and update statuses in one tap.
f.4p: Medication, dosage, frequency and duration — reuse a previous prescription in seconds and print it.
f.5p: Work across clinics from one account. Nurses get a preferred clinic that pre-fills every new visit.
f.6p: Visits, waiting, completed, new patients and follow-ups — by clinic, for today, this week, this month or any range.
roles.p: Doctors own the clinical record. Nurses run the day. Each sees exactly what their role needs.
rd.p: Everything clinical, in one record — plus full control of your clinics, nurses and reports.
rd.1: Chief complaint, diagnosis, notes & follow-up date on every visit
rd.2: Structured prescriptions you can reuse and print
rd.3: Private General Notes per patient, never visible to nurses
rd.4: Manage clinics and nurses, restore removed patients
rd.5: Dashboards across all clinics and any date range
rn.p: Check patients in, book visits and keep every queue moving — without ever touching medical data.
rn.1: Search and register patients, edit basic details
rn.2: Create, edit and cancel visits; update statuses
rn.3: Primary queue operator — reorder scheduled & waiting patients
rn.4: No diagnoses, doctor notes, prescriptions or General Notes
rn.5: No deleting patients or approving duplicate phones
sec.t: Your patients' medicine stays between you and them
sec.1p: Permissions are checked by the backend on every request — hiding a button is never the security boundary.
sec.2p: Each doctor's clinics, nurses, visits and notes are walled off from every other doctor on the platform.
sec.3p: Status changes, queue reordering, medical edits and prescriptions are logged with who, when, and what changed.
sec.4p: Cancelled visits, deactivated clinics and removed patients are preserved — history is never lost.
sh.2s: Patients · visits · queue — no medical data
sh.3s: Plans & subscriptions — no automatic medical access
sh.4s: One doctor never sees another doctor's data

pr.t: Pick the plan that fits your practice
pr.p: Prices in Egyptian pounds. Pay for longer and get up to 2 months free.
pr.note: Unlimited patients and visits on every plan. Try Professional free for 14 days. No online payment needed: our team contacts you to activate.
q1: Can my nurse see diagnoses or prescriptions?
a1: No. Nurses manage patients, visits and the queue only. Chief complaint, diagnosis, doctor notes, prescriptions, follow-up details and General Notes are doctor-only, and the server enforces it.
a2: Choose a plan and send us your details. Our team contacts you, payment is handled directly, and we activate your subscription. Online payment is coming later.
q3: What does "1 month free" mean on Basic?
a3: Basic starts with a free month. It's also added to paid terms: a 6-month purchase gives you 7 months, and a 1-year purchase gives you 13 months.
q4: What happens when my subscription ends?
a4: Access for you and your nurses pauses until you renew. All of your data is preserved — nothing is deleted.
q5: Is there a limit on the number of patients?
a5: No. Every plan includes unlimited patients and unlimited visits. Plans differ only in the number of clinics and nurses.
q6: Can I work across more than one clinic?
a6: Yes. Professional includes two clinics, each with its own independent queue. Reports can combine all clinics or focus on one.
c.p: Tell us about your practice and we'll reach out to set up your plan — usually within one business day.
